source_assumptions: Representative lesser monsters; no superior/bosses, quest/task gates or Slayer training. Metadata retains required levels and precise XP only.
Killerwatt approaches melee and uses ranged when out of reach. Exact click/limb transformation and attack-mode exploit not reproduced; native30-yard range. Boots reduce max15 to melee6/ranged8.

Nagua hit components roll independent accuracy/damage in one server attack event; source timing/correlation unspecified. Negative flat armour uses existing player melee pipeline. Frost icicle/prayer special deferred. Earthen reinforcement below60% supported; crush-special weakening/burn clearing deferred.

Spectre nose protection restores max8 source magic; without it hit always accurate and max14. Persistent XP is never drained to simulate temporary skills. Basilisk stat drains/gaze and mirror requirement deferred; mirror shield is equipable but has no scripted gaze benefit yet.
Aquanite slash auto-attacks sever the lure even on a miss, reducing Stab defence60 to10 until reset. Stock Sporebat has no removable lure model. Only existing equipment melee-lane definitions apply.

Araxyte venom starts6, rises2 each18-second tick to20, remains until native poison dispel/death;25% application after positive melee damage is prototype choice. WoW poison dispels cure fully; no OSRS antivenom/inventory consumable system.
